name: Samsung C&T Corporation
summary: Samsung C&T Corporation engages in the engineering and construction, trading and investment, fashion, and resort businesses in South Korea, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas. Its engineering and construction business cover building, civil infrastructure, plant, housing construction, electrical testing, commissioning, engineering, operations and maintenance, equipment hire, and calibration services.
